reason: I'd probably poke at it on the trial like I do with everything, but three days with a card on file isn't enough to see if a single DM gets a reply, and I'd cancel before day 4. Nobody has published a result yet, so I'm not paying $147 on faith.

would_change_my_mind: Real published results from coaches like me (reply and booked-call numbers from actual accounts), plus a longer trial or a money-back window so I can judge reply rates instead of just looking at drafts.
